name: jlc-2layer-1oz
fab: JLCPCB standard 2-layer FR-4, 1 oz outer copper, HASL/ENIG
note: Design values sit at or above JLC's stated minimums, preferring their 'recommended' figures and no-surcharge options. Each entry: [value_mm, JLC's figure].

min_track_width: min track 0.10 mm (1 oz, 1-2 layer); 0.127 keeps margin for the +/-20 % width tolerance
min_clearance: track spacing 0.10 mm; SMD pad to pad (different nets) 0.15 mm
min_via_annular_width: via diameter 0.1 mm (0.15 preferred) larger than the hole
min_through_hole_diameter: min via hole 0.15 mm, preferred >= 0.2; holes 0.2/0.25 with diameter < 0.45 cost more
min_copper_edge_clearance: copper to routed edge >= 0.2 mm; 0.3 for the +/-0.2 mm outline tolerance

pth_annular_width: PTH annular ring, 2-layer 1 oz: recommended 0.25, absolute minimum 0.18 mm
pth_hole_clearance: PTH to track: minimum 0.28 mm, 0.35 recommended

solder_mask_min_width: soldermask bridge 0.10 mm (1 oz, green); not a project setting: sch_to_board writes it
